problems.statementHtml: What value of \(x\) satisfies \[x- \frac{3}{4} = \frac{5}{12} - \frac{1}{3}?\]
problems.statementZhHtml: 哪个 \(x\) 的值满足下式？\[x- \frac{3}{4} = \frac{5}{12} - \frac{1}{3}\text{？}\]

problems.statementHtml: The numbers \(3,\) \(5,\) \(7,\) \(a,\) and \(b\) have an average (arithmetic mean) of \(15.\) What is the average of \(a\) and \(b?\)

Assuming \(a
eq3,\) \(b
eq4,\) and \(c
eq5,\) what is the value in simplest form of the following expression? \[ rac{a-3}{5-c} \cdot  rac{b-4}{3-a} \cdot  rac{c-5}{4-b}\]
problems.statementZhHtml:
假设 \(a
eq3\)、\(b
eq4\)、\(c
eq5\)，下列表达式的最简值是多少？\[ rac{a-3}{5-c} \cdot  rac{b-4}{3-a} \cdot  rac{c-5}{4-b}\]

problems.statementHtml: A driver travels for \(2\) hours at \(60\) miles per hour, during which her car gets \(30\) miles per gallon of gasoline. She is paid \(\$0.50\) per mile, and her only expense is gasoline at \(\$2.00\) per gallon. What is her net rate of pay, in dollars per hour, after this expense?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一名司机开车 \(2\) 小时，速度为每小时 \(60\) 英里，在此期间汽车每加仑汽油可行驶 \(30\) 英里。她每行驶一英里获得 \(\$0.50\) 报酬，唯一开销是每加仑价格为 \(\$2.00\) 的汽油。扣除汽油费用后，她每小时的净报酬是多少美元？

problems.statementHtml: What is the sum of all real numbers \(x\) for which \[|x^2-12x+34|=2?\]
problems.statementZhHtml: 所有满足下式的实数 \(x\) 之和是多少？\[|x^2-12x+34|=2\text{？}\]

problems.statementHtml: How many \(4\)-digit positive integers (that is, integers between \(1000\) and \(9999,\) inclusive) having only even digits are divisible by \(5?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 有多少个 \(4\) 位正整数，也就是 \(1000\) 到 \(9999\) 之间的整数，只含偶数数字且能被 \(5\) 整除？

problems.statementHtml: The \(25\) integers from \(-10\) to \(14,\) inclusive, can be arranged to form a \(5\)-by-\(5\) square in which the sum of the numbers in each row, the sum of the numbers in each column, and the sum of the numbers along each of the main diagonals are all the same. What is the value of this common sum?
problems.statementZhHtml: \(25\) 个从 \(-10\) 到 \(14\) 的整数可以排列成一个 \(5\) 乘 \(5\) 的方阵，使每一行、每一列以及两条主对角线上的数之和都相同。这个公共和是多少？

problems.statementHtml: What is the value of \[ \begin{aligned} &1+2+3-4+5+6+7-8\\ &\quad+\cdots\\ &\quad+197+198+199-200? \end{aligned} \]
problems.statementZhHtml: 求下列表达式的值：\[ \begin{aligned} &1+2+3-4+5+6+7-8\\ &\quad+\cdots\\ &\quad+197+198+199-200 \end{aligned}\text{？}\]

problems.statementHtml: A single bench section at a school event can hold either \(7\) adults or \(11\) children. When \(N\) bench sections are connected end to end, an equal number of adults and children seated together will occupy all the bench space. What is the least possible positive integer value of \(N?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 学校活动中，一个长凳单元可以坐 \(7\) 名成人或 \(11\) 名儿童。当 \(N\) 个长凳单元首尾相连时，相同人数的成人和儿童一起就坐，刚好占满所有长凳空间。\(N\) 的最小正整数值是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Seven cubes, whose volumes are \(1,\) \(8,\) \(27,\) \(64,\) \(125,\) \(216,\) and \(343\) cubic units, are stacked vertically to form a tower in which the volumes of the cubes decrease from bottom to top. Except for the bottom cube, the bottom face of each cube lies completely on top of the cube below it. What is the total surface area of the tower (including the bottom) in square units?
problems.statementZhHtml: 七个立方体的体积分别为 \(1\)、\(8\)、\(27\)、\(64\)、\(125\)、\(216\) 和 \(343\) 立方单位。它们竖直堆成一座塔，体积从底部到顶部递减。除最底部的立方体外，每个立方体的底面都完全位于其下方立方体的顶面上。求这座塔的总表面积，包括底面。

problems.statementHtml: What is the median of the following list of \(4040\) numbers? \[ \begin{aligned} &1,2,3,\ldots,2020,\\ &1^2,2^2,3^2,\ldots,2020^2 \end{aligned} \]
problems.statementZhHtml: 下列 \(4040\) 个数的列表的中位数是多少？\[ \begin{aligned} &1,2,3,\ldots,2020,\\ &1^2,2^2,3^2,\ldots,2020^2 \end{aligned} \]

problems.statementHtml: Triangle \(AMC\) is isosceles with \(AM = AC.\) Medians \(\overline{MV}\) and \(\overline{CU}\) are perpendicular to each other, and \(MV=CU=12.\) What is the area of \(\triangle AMC?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 三角形 \(AMC\) 是等腰三角形，且 \(AM = AC\)。中线 \(\overline{MV}\) 和 \(\overline{CU}\) 互相垂直，并且 \(MV=CU=12\)。求 \(\triangle AMC\) 的面积。

problems.statementHtml: A frog sitting at the point \((1, 2)\) begins a sequence of jumps, where each jump is parallel to one of the coordinate axes and has length \(1,\) and the direction of each jump (up, down, right, or left) is chosen independently at random. The sequence ends when the frog reaches a side of the square with vertices \((0, 0),\) \((0, 4),\) \((4, 4),\) and \((4, 0).\) What is the probability that the sequence of jumps ends on a vertical side of the square?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一只青蛙坐在点 \((1, 2)\)，开始连续跳跃。每次跳跃都平行于某条坐标轴，长度为 \(1\)，方向为上、下、右、左之一，且每次独立随机选择。当青蛙到达以 \((0, 0)\)、\((0, 4)\)、\((4, 4)\) 和 \((4, 0)\) 为顶点的正方形的一条边时，跳跃序列结束。跳跃序列在正方形的竖直边上结束的概率是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Real numbers \(x\) and \(y\) satisfy \(x + y = 4\) and \(x \cdot y = -2.\) What is the value of \[x + \frac{x^3}{y^2} + \frac{y^3}{x^2} + y?\]
problems.statementZhHtml: 实数 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 满足 \(x + y = 4\) 且 \(x \cdot y = -2\)。求下列表达式的值：\[x + \frac{x^3}{y^2} + \frac{y^3}{x^2} + y\text{？}\]

problems.statementHtml: A positive integer divisor of \(12!\) is chosen at random. The probability that the divisor chosen is a perfect square can be expressed as \(\frac{m}{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(m+n?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 从 \(12!\) 的正整数因数中随机选一个。所选因数为完全平方数的概率可写为 \(\frac{m}{n}\)，其中 \(m\)、\(n\) 为互质正整数。求 \(m+n\)。

problems.statementHtml: A point is chosen at random within the square in the coordinate plane whose vertices are \((0, 0),\) \((2020, 0),\) \((2020, 2020),\) and \((0, 2020).\) The probability that the point is within \(d\) units of a lattice point is \(\tfrac{1}{2}.\) (A point \((x, y)\) is a lattice point if \(x\) and \(y\) are both integers.) What is \(d\) to the nearest tenth?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在坐标平面中，从顶点为 \((0, 0)\)、\((2020, 0)\)、\((2020, 2020)\) 和 \((0, 2020)\) 的正方形内部随机选一点。该点距离某个格点不超过 \(d\) 个单位的概率为 \(\tfrac{1}{2}\)。其中格点指坐标 \((x, y)\) 中 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 均为整数的点。求 \(d\) 四舍五入到最接近的十分位是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Define \[ \begin{aligned} P(x)={}&(x-1^2)(x-2^2)\\ &\cdots(x-100^2). \end{aligned} \] How many integers \(n\) are there such that \(P(n)\leq 0?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 定义 \[ \begin{aligned} P(x)={}&(x-1^2)(x-2^2)\\ &\cdots(x-100^2) \end{aligned}\text{。}\] 有多少个整数 \(n\) 满足 \(P(n)\leq 0\)？

problems.statementHtml: Let \((a,b,c,d)\) be an ordered quadruple of not necessarily distinct integers, each one of them in the set \(\{0,1,2,3\}.\) For how many such quadruples is it true that \(a\cdot d-b\cdot c\) is odd? (For example, \((0,3,1,1)\) is one such quadruple, because \(0\cdot 1-3\cdot 1 = -3\) is odd.)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \((a,b,c,d)\) 为一个有序四元组，其中每个数都是集合 \(\{0,1,2,3\}\) 中的整数，且不要求互不相同。有多少个这样的四元组满足 \(a\cdot d-b\cdot c\) 为奇数？例如，\((0,3,1,1)\) 是一个这样的四元组，因为 \(0\cdot 1-3\cdot 1 = -3\) 为奇数。

problems.statementHtml: As shown in the figure below, a regular dodecahedron (the polyhedron consisting of \(12\) congruent regular pentagonal faces) floats in space with two horizontal faces. Note that there is a ring of five slanted faces adjacent to the top face, and a ring of five slanted faces adjacent to the bottom face. How many ways are there to move from the top face to the bottom face via a sequence of adjacent faces so that each face is visited at most once and moves are not permitted from the bottom ring to the top ring?
problems.statementZhHtml: 如下图所示，一个正十二面体，也就是由 \(12\) 个全等正五边形面组成的多面体，漂浮在空间中，并有两个水平面。注意，顶面相邻有一圈五个倾斜面，底面相邻也有一圈五个倾斜面。从顶面出发，经由一系列相邻面移动到底面，且每个面至多访问一次，并且不允许从底部环移动到顶部环。这样的走法有多少种？

problems.statementHtml: Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) satisfies \(\angle ABC = \angle ACD = 90^{\circ},\) \(AC=20,\) and \(CD=30.\) Diagonals \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{BD}\) intersect at point \(E,\) and \(AE=5.\) What is the area of quadrilateral \(ABCD?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 四边形 \(ABCD\) 满足 \(\angle ABC = \angle ACD = 90^{\circ}\)、\(AC=20\)、\(CD=30\)。对角线 \(\overline{AC}\) 和 \(\overline{BD}\) 交于点 \(E\)，且 \(AE=5\)。求四边形 \(ABCD\) 的面积。

problems.statementHtml: There exists a unique strictly increasing sequence of nonnegative integers \(a_1<a_2<\cdots<a_k\) such that \[\frac{2^{289}+1}{2^{17}+1}=2^{a_1}+2^{a_2}+\cdots+2^{a_k}.\] What is \(k?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 存在唯一严格递增的非负整数序列 \(a_1<a_2<\cdots<a_k\)，使得 \[\frac{2^{289}+1}{2^{17}+1}=2^{a_1}+2^{a_2}+\cdots+2^{a_k}\text{。}\] 求 \(k\)。

problems.statementHtml: For how many positive integers \(n \le 1000\) is\[\left\lfloor \dfrac{998}{n} \right\rfloor+\left\lfloor \dfrac{999}{n} \right\rfloor+\left\lfloor \dfrac{1000}{n}\right \rfloor\]not divisible by \(3?\) (Recall that \(\lfloor x \rfloor\) is the greatest integer less than or equal to \(x.\))
problems.statementZhHtml: 有多少个正整数 \(n \le 1000\)，使得 \[\left\lfloor \dfrac{998}{n} \right\rfloor+\left\lfloor \dfrac{999}{n} \right\rfloor+\left\lfloor \dfrac{1000}{n}\right \rfloor\] 不能被 \(3\) 整除？这里 \(\lfloor x \rfloor\) 表示不超过 \(x\) 的最大整数。

problems.statementHtml: Let \(T\) be the triangle in the coordinate plane with vertices \((0,0),\) \((4,0),\) and \((0,3).\) Consider the following five isometries (rigid transformations) of the plane: rotations of \(90^{\circ},\) \(180^{\circ},\) and \(270^{\circ}\) counterclockwise around the origin, reflection across the \(x\)-axis, and reflection across the \(y\)-axis. How many of the \(125\) sequences of three of these transformations (not necessarily distinct) will return \(T\) to its original position? (For example, a \(180^{\circ}\) rotation, followed by a reflection across the \(x\)-axis, followed by a reflection across the \(y\)-axis will return \(T\) to its original position, but a \(90^{\circ}\) rotation, followed by a reflection across the \(x\)-axis, followed by another reflection across the \(x\)-axis will not return \(T\) to its original position.)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(T\) 为坐标平面中顶点为 \((0,0)\)，\((4,0)\) 和 \((0,3)\) 的三角形。考虑平面上的下列五个等距变换：绕原点逆时针旋转 \(90^{\circ}\)，\(180^{\circ}\) 和 \(270^{\circ}\)，关于 \(x\) 轴反射，关于 \(y\) 轴反射。在这五个变换中选取三个组成序列，允许重复，共 \(125\) 个序列，其中有多少个会把 \(T\) 变回原来的位置？例如，先旋转 \(180^{\circ}\)，再关于 \(x\) 轴反射，再关于 \(y\) 轴反射，会把 \(T\) 变回原位；但先旋转 \(90^{\circ}\)，再关于 \(x\) 轴反射，再关于 \(x\) 轴反射，则不会把 \(T\) 变回原位。

problems.statementHtml: Let \(n\) be the least positive integer greater than \(1000\) for which \[ \begin{gathered} \gcd(63,n+120)=21\\ \text{and}\\ \gcd(n+63,120)=60. \end{gathered} \] What is the sum of the digits of \(n?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(n\) 为大于 \(1000\) 的最小正整数，满足 \[ \begin{gathered} \gcd(63,n+120)=21\\ \text{且}\\ \gcd(n+63,120)=60 \end{gathered}\text{。}\] \(n\) 的各位数字之和是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Jason rolls three fair standard six-sided dice. Then he looks at the rolls and chooses a subset of the dice (possibly empty, possibly all three dice) to reroll. After rerolling, he wins if and only if the sum of the numbers face up on the three dice is exactly \(7.\) Jason always plays to optimize his chances of winning. What is the probability that he chooses to reroll exactly two of the dice?
problems.statementZhHtml: Jason 掷三枚公平的标准六面骰。然后他查看结果，并选择其中一个骰子子集重新掷，子集可以为空，也可以是全部三枚。重新掷后，他获胜的条件是三枚骰子朝上的点数之和恰好为 \(7\)。Jason 总是采用使获胜概率最大的策略。他选择恰好重新掷两枚骰子的概率是多少？
